help_topics.title: Fees
help_topics.summary: The full Ryanair fee table: bags, seats, check-in and changes, online vs at the airport.
body: Ryanair keeps its lowest prices online. Buying at the airport or through the call centre always costs more. The table below lists the fees that apply to bookings made on this website (gb/en market, GBP).
A card payment processing fee of 2% of the total booking value is applied once the card number has been entered. The fee is always shown as a separate line in the price breakdown before you pay.
Optional SMS flight updates cost £2.99 per booking and cover both outbound and return flights.

help_topics.title: Cabin Bag Policy
help_topics.summary: What you can bring on board: the free small bag, the 10kg cabin bag and Priority & 2 Cabin Bags.
body: 1 small bag - included with every fare
Every passenger can bring one small bag measuring 40 x 30 x 20cm, which must fit under the seat in front of you. No weight limit applies, but it must fit in the sizer at the gate.

Priority Boarding and 2 Cabin Bags (from £16.00 per person, per flight) lets you bring a 55 x 40 x 20cm 10kg bag plus your small bag, board first through the priority lane, and guarantee overhead locker space.
Non-priority passengers whose 10kg bag does not fit in the sizer must pay the gate bag fee of £/€25 and the bag travels in the hold.

help_topics.title: Check-in Bag Options
help_topics.summary: 10kg, 20kg and 23kg checked bag prices online versus at the airport.
body: Buy online, save at the airport

A 10kg check-in bag costs £11.49 online or £15.99 at the airport. The 20kg check-in bag costs £25.49 online versus £50.00 at the airport, and the 23kg bag £34.49 online versus £68.00 at the airport. Up to 3 bags of 20kg may be purchased per passenger per flight.
Passengers on the same booking can pool their purchased check-in allowance at the bag drop desk.
Sports, music and baby equipment can be added to any booking from £15.00 per item per flight.

help_topics.title: Online Check-in & Boarding Passes
help_topics.summary: When check-in opens, how to get your boarding pass, and what happens if you have not checked in.
body: Customers who have purchased an allocated seat can check in online from 60 days before departure until 2 hours before the scheduled flight. Customers travelling on a randomly allocated seat can check in from 24 hours before departure until 2 hours before.
Boarding passes are digital: the Ryanair app displays the QR code. Paper boarding passes are no longer issued at the airport; a re-issued boarding pass costs £20 per passenger.
If you do not check in online
Customers who have not checked in online at least 2 hours before departure must pay the airport check-in fee of £55 per passenger (€30 for flights departing Spain, €40 for Austria).

help_topics.title: Travel Documents
help_topics.summary: Passports, national ID cards and entry requirements for Ryanair routes.
body: All passengers must present a valid travel document: a machine-readable passport, or a national ID card on routes where it is accepted. Your document must match the name on the booking exactly.
UK passport holders travelling to the EU
Your passport must have been issued less than 10 years before the date you enter the country and be valid for at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave.
Non-EEA nationals must travel with a valid passport and any visa required for entry. It is your responsibility to confirm the entry requirements of every country on your booking.

help_topics.title: Flight Changes & Name Changes
help_topics.summary: How to change a flight date or a passenger name, and the fees that apply.
body: You can change the date of any flight up to 2.5 hours before departure. The online change fee is £/€45 per passenger per flight, plus any fare difference. Flexi Plus customers change flights with no change fee and only pay the fare difference.
Passenger names can be corrected online up to 2 hours before departure. The name change fee is £/€115 per booking.
Flexi Plus customers may move to an earlier flight on the same day at no charge, subject to seat availability.

help_topics.title: Allocated Seats
help_topics.summary: How seat selection works, the seat bands on board, and random allocation at check-in.
body: Seats can be selected during booking or via My bookings up to 2 hours before departure. XL rows 1-2 offer the most legroom (from £21.50); Get Off Quick rows 2-6 cost from £14.00; Best Value Up Front rows 7-15 from £13.50; XL rows 16-17 from £14.50; Best Value At The Back rows 18-33 from £9.50.
Customers who do not select a seat are allocated a seat at check-in free of charge. Randomly allocated seats open at check-in 24 hours before departure and may separate groups travelling together.

help_topics.title: Payment & Card Fees
help_topics.summary: Accepted payment methods and the card processing fee.
body: Ryanair accepts Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Diners Club, Discover, UATP and PayPal. Pay by Bank is available for eligible UK bank accounts with no card processing fee.
A fee of 2% of the booking total applies to credit and debit card payments. The fee appears in the price breakdown after the card number is entered.
Business travellers can request an invoice during payment instead of paying immediately.

help_topics.title: Refunds & Compensation
help_topics.summary: Refund timelines, EU261 compensation for disruption, and the Refund Hub.
body: Approved refunds are processed within 7 working days back to the original payment method. It can take up to 10 working days for the amount to appear on your statement.

If your flight is cancelled you can choose between a full refund and a free move to the next available flight. Depending on the notice given and the rerouting offered, compensation of £/€250-£/€400 per passenger may apply for flights under 1,500km.
Refund requests are submitted through the Refund Hub with the booking reference and the email address used at booking.

help_topics.title: Special Assistance
help_topics.summary: Requesting assistance for reduced-mobility passengers and medical conditions.
body: Assistance can be requested free of charge up to 2 hours before departure through the special assistance form or at the airport assistance desk. Please arrive at the meeting point at least 30 minutes before departure.
Passengers with medical conditions should carry a medical certificate. Medical equipment up to 2 items travels free of charge in addition to your cabin allowance.

help_topics.title: Children & Infants
help_topics.summary: Fares, baggage and seating rules for infants, children and teens travelling with adults.
body: Infants travel on an adult’s lap for a fixed £/€25 fee per flight. Infants do not receive a cabin bag allowance but a 5kg bag of baby items may be checked in free of charge.
Children must be accompanied by an adult aged 16 or over. Teens may travel alone with a signed parental consent form presented at check-in.
Adults travelling with children under 12 are assigned seats together with at least one child when they check in, even without a paid seat selection.

help_topics.title: Security Fast Track
help_topics.summary: Skip the security queue at participating airports.
body: Security Fast Track gives you access to a dedicated security lane with shorter queues. At London Stansted it costs £8.49 per person and at Dublin £12.03 per person. Fast Track can be added during booking or via My bookings up to 2 hours before departure.
Fast Track is included with the Plus and Flexi Plus fares at airports where the service operates.

help_topics.title: Priority Boarding
help_topics.summary: Board first and guarantee overhead locker space.
body: Priority Boarding lets you board the aircraft first through the dedicated priority lane. It is sold together with the 10kg cabin bag as Priority & 2 Cabin Bags from £16.00 per person, per flight, and is included with Regular, Plus and Flexi Plus fares.

help_topics.title: Group Travel
help_topics.summary: Discounted fares for groups of 15 or more.
body: Groups of 15 or more passengers can request a discounted group fare through the group travel form. Group bookings include name flexibility up to 2 hours before departure and a dedicated support team.

help_topics.title: Promo Codes & Newsletter
help_topics.summary: How to apply a promo code when searching and what the newsletter welcome offer includes.
body: Enter the code in the promo code field of the flight search widget before you search. The discount is applied to the flight fare for every passenger on the booking and is reflected in the price breakdown. Only one promo code can be used per booking.
New newsletter subscribers receive the welcome code RYANAIR10, which gives 10% off the flight fare. Flash sale codes are published on the homepage banner from time to time.
Promo codes apply to the flight fare only; seats, bags and extras are charged at the standard prices. Codes cannot be applied to bookings already made.

help_topics.title: On Board
help_topics.summary: Inflight menu, pre-paid credit and using the app on board.
body: A full food and drink menu is available on every flight, including hot drinks, snacks and sandwiches. Pre-paid inflight credit gives you 10% extra credit free: buy £4.31 - £17.24 of credit and use it on any inflight purchase.
Receipts for onboard purchases are issued through the inflight receipts portal using your seat number and flight date.

help_topics.title: General terms & conditions of carriage
help_topics.summary: The conditions of carriage that apply to every booking: your contract, check-in deadlines, baggage, delays and your rights.
body: Your booking confirmation together with these general terms & conditions of carriage (GTCC) forms the contract between you and Ryanair for the flights shown on it. By completing a booking you accept these conditions on behalf of every passenger in the booking.

Online check-in opens 60 days before departure for customers who purchased an allocated seat and 24 hours before departure for customers travelling on a randomly allocated seat, and always closes 2 hours before the scheduled departure. Boarding closes 30 minutes before departure and the gate is not reopened for late passengers.

Every fare includes a free small personal bag that must fit under the seat in front of you. Priority & 2 Cabin Bags customers may bring a 10kg cabin bag and a small bag on board. Checked bags of 10kg, 20kg and 23kg can be added per passenger per flight; airport bag drop opens 2 hours before departure.

If a flight is cancelled you can choose between a full refund and a free move to the next available flight; EU261 compensation may also apply depending on the notice given. See the Refunds article for refund timelines and the EU261 rules that apply to disrupted flights.

Flight dates can be changed up to 2.5 hours before departure and passenger names up to 2 hours before departure. The change fees and the fare difference are shown before you confirm the change; Flexi Plus customers change flights with no change fee.
